ios.desc:
DingTalk · Work Smarter, Work with AI
DingTalk brings AI into the workflows you use every day — messaging, docs, meetings, business tables, and more. No need to learn another tool just to open DingTalk, and AI is ready to help.
【Qwenwork · AI office platform in symbiosis with DingTalk】
DingTalk handles collaboration. Qwenwork handles the work — reply to messages, process files, research, design, and build webpages. Just ask, and it gets to work.
【DingTalk AI Minutes · Recording in the AI Era】
When the meeting ends, the notes are already done — speakers identified, long recordings split into chapters, and key points and action items automatically highlighted.
【DingTalk AI Table · One Table, One Business】
Let AI write formulas, analyze data, and create charts. Turn the same data into dashboards, calendars, or Gantt charts, with automated reminders and notifications. Start with a smart table; go further and build business systems without coding.
【DingTalk Meetings · Capture Every Key Decision in Real Time】
AI noise reduction keeps voices clear; real-time captions support multilingual translation and speaker identification; join late and instantly catch up; ask AI whenever something is unclear. After the meeting, summaries and action items are generated automatically — no note-taking needed.
【DingTalk Docs · No More Staring at a Blank Page】
From plans and ideas to organizing information, start with a thought and let AI Creation help you build it out — no more struggling to start from scratch.

For assistance, please go to Me > Help & Support > Online Service / Hotline. Your experience is our
